system.description:
Creates visible or audible images detectable by all, not just mentally targeted illusions. Useful for distraction, deception, or communication.
Level 1: Tiny projection (10 cm radius)
Level 2: Small projection (1 m radius)
Level 3: Moderately sized projection (10 m radius)
Level 4: Building-size projection (100 m radius)
Level 5: Neighbourhood-sized projection (1 km radius)
Level 6: City-sized projection (10 km radius)
